performance.snapshotContext: Dev watcher resumed after serial local/UI/unit qualification; not a matched benchmark.
performance.io: Profile uses one native save request. Image conversion/storage remains the original backend media flow. Returning login reads existing consent instead of overwriting it; a first consent requires one additional read before its initial save, matching the native consent precedence. Local artificial route delays are retained.
performance.limit: No throughput or latency parity claim from single CPU samples. No backend code change or repeated stress test in this batch.
